name: Ravenskar Fleece Pullover Hoodie
description:
A heavyweight pullover hoodie from Ravenskar, a mid-tier Scandinavian-heritage label that manufactures out of the Milwaukee industrial belt. The fleece interior is dense and slow to lose warmth — this is a hoodie designed for people who work in cold warehouses or walk long exposed stretches between transit stops. The exterior is a brushed cotton-poly shell in deep navy, forest green, or charcoal, with a front kangaroo pocket large enough to fit a full-size datapad.

The hood itself has a structured brim that doesn't collapse into your face in wind, and the drawcords are flat-woven with metal tips rather than cheap plastic. No logo on the chest — just a small embroidered 'R' mark on the left sleeve cuff. Workers, students, and off-shift medics wear this without irony. It's warm. It lasts.
what_it_says: You prioritize function over fashion, and you've got enough sense to buy something that'll last three winters.
story_hooks: Ravenskar's Milwaukee plant is the site of a quiet labor dispute — workers are sewing coded symbols into the embroidery of a specific batch as a form of protest communication.
A character's hoodie contains a handwritten note tucked into the kangaroo pocket lining — a stitch-worker's name, a tier-block address, and three words: 'Don't forget us.'
The forest green colorway from a specific production year has become the unofficial color of a Tier 2 mutual aid network; wearing it in the right neighborhood signals you're safe to ask for help.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sturdy, practical pullover with clean lines and understated Scandinavian minimalism. Sits on the body like reliable infrastructure—broad shoulders, slightly relaxed through the torso, with a centered kangaroo pocket that dominates the front visual real estate. The structured hood reads as intentional rather than casual, with a defined brim that frames the face without swallowing it.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed but not oversized—cut for layering over undergarments or light thermal wear. Sleeves reach the wrist with enough room for augmentation bulges without binding. Torso length sits at the hip, balanced between mobility and coverage.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed cotton-poly blend shell exterior (60% cotton, 40% synthetic) with dense fleece lining underneath. The outer surface has a subtle nap that catches light softly.
physical_description.texture: Exterior: brushed and matte, slightly fuzzy to the touch with directional grain. Interior: thick, plush fleece that compresses slightly under pressure but springs back. Drawcords are flat-woven with visible weave texture, tipped with small brushed-metal cylinders.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary colors: deep navy blue, forest green, or charcoal gray. No patterns or accent colors—monochromatic aesthetic with subtle tonal variation from the brushing process. Metal drawcord tips add minimal warm metallic accent.
physical_description.closures: Pullover style with no front zipper. Flat-woven drawcords with metal tips thread through reinforced eyelets in the hood brim. No buttons, snaps, or magnetic closures.
distinctive_features: Structured hood brim with internal wire or flexible stay to prevent collapse
Oversized kangaroo pocket dimensioned for standard datapad (approximately 25cm wide)
Small embroidered 'R' mark on left sleeve cuff—only branding
Flat-woven metal-tipped drawcords rather than cord with plastic aglets
Reinforced stitching at stress points (pocket seams, hood attachment, sleeve openings)
Internal neck tape in matching fabric for comfort
Intentional absence of exterior logos or corporate branding
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional—solidly working-class apparel with no luxury markers but clear quality investment
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by warehouse workers, transit maintenance crews, off-shift medical technicians, students commuting across the GLMZ cold seasons, and anyone prioritizing warmth and durability over status signaling. The 'R' cuff mark reads as humble manufacturer pride rather than flex. Signals reliability, practical intelligence, and Scandinavian-heritage manufacturing legacy.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and well-maintained. Shows gentle wear at pocket edges and cuff friction points after months of use. Fleece interior may pill slightly but remains warm. Metal drawcord tips remain bright. No patches required if cared for—this is a garment built to age gracefully under working conditions.
